search_log: Listed every filing of Harmony Biosciences Holdings (CIK 1802665; first filing 2020-02, IPO August 2020) via data.sec.gov/submissions; selected 8-Ks with item 2.02 and every 10-Q/10-K; parsed every table row.

2019Q4: prior-year column of the 2020Q4 release; 2020Q1 and 2020Q2: prior-year columns of the 2021Q1 and 2021Q2 10-Qs (no Harmony periodic filing covers those quarters as current; the S-1 is not an allowed source). 2020Q3 on: 'Net product revenue(s)' of each quarter's release, or the 10-Q where no release table was filed (2021Q2).
Checks: every Q4 release prints the full year, and the four quarters sum to it (verify_staged_manifests sum check).
